dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: Ooh... These are some fine pieces of Azurite and Vermillionite!

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: My thanks to you both. Here's your payment.

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: None of your efforts are wasted. Every piece adds that bit more luster and color to Lantern Rite.

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: Since you're staying in Liyue during the festival, make sure to keep an eye on the Mingxiao Lantern.

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: As the work progresses, the construction site at the harbor will become more and more magnificent to behold.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Sounds fascinating. {NICKNAME}, how about we take a look now?
